text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: —Umamusume of the Mejiro family. Yes, ever since we were little children, we've always...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I grew up listening to wonderful "stories."
Dreamlike tales of the elder Mejiro sisters achieving great feats.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the deep snows of Mount Yotei——
our progenitor descended.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It awakened the 'Mother Mountain,' and from the
benevolence-soaked earth, 'Giants' were born—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, all the children began to awaken.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro Umamusume ran. Swift as the wind.
Across fields, flower gardens, deserts, and snowy plains.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Through racing, she thrilled so many people,
moved their hearts, and spread smiles all around.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yes, every Mejiro horse girl is someone to look up to. Every one of them... a child of light."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: (That is why all of us dreamed of one day becoming like our wonderful elder peers.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(If everyone is a child of light, then each and every person
must possess the brilliance of Mejiro.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(To us in that state, our beloved
grandmother bestowed her words upon us.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"Each of you, of course,
has your own unique strengths."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to make your mark as a Mejiro Umamusume,
it would be wise to make the most of that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, you shall run long distance.
Ryan, you must hone your burst of speed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Ardan, hone your resolve.
Palmer, work on your grit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Dober, hone your mental strength.
And Bright, you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~, Grandmother.
And what about myself...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
You...
keep a close eye on everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Look... closely? Um...
Is that all I need to do~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: —That is all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(I too should be a child of the light.
Yet everyone in the Mejiro family said this to me:)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(“You don't need to run.
Just watch from the sidelines,” he said.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Even from my revered grandmother.
Yet, even for someone like me...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(—Spring has arrived. The spring we've so longed for.
Enrolling in Tracen Academy, and then...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, dear Trainer~.
I'll be in your care once again starting today~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't... shown me the way.
Would you please watch over the spring together with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Of course!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(For I have been blessed to meet a Trainer
who walks beside me in lockstep
and offers me guidance.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My true spring is finally about to begin
from this very moment~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ So, dear Trainer,
my debut in the Twinkle Series has
finally been decided, has it~?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes~. Um~, so~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When will I be able to participate
in the Twinkle Series~?
choice_data_list: Of course, once you've finished your Make Debut...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~? Ah, that makes sense~.
Well then~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let us devote ourselves diligently starting today~.
I shall do my best for the sake of the Mejiro family~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My trainee Mejiro Bright is, as her name suggests,
an Umamusume from the prestigious Mejiro family.
However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Howaa~, fuwaa~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even among high-born ladies, she is exceptionally laid-back.
Her starts are late, and she makes her move late as well.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... haa...!
If I hear their voices, I can run even more...
If I can just hear their voices—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “Bright!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
! Yes...!
I need to... hurry here...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ever since I was a child, all the way until now... I've done nothing but let down so many people who believed in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
――As a Mejiro Umamusume,
this is truly shameful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: —To become a new light for the Mejiro family...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not that she lacks motivation or talent.
She just can't keep up with the flow and hasn't
grasped when to make her move yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As long as we teach her the right timing, she can
make a solid late push. In races,
and outside of them too—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And alongside Mejiro Bright, another Mejiro
will make her debut in the same class.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "It's finally time, Bright. The Twinkle Series we've been waiting for so long."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome, Dober~♪
Indeed it is~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Mejiro Dober. Another cool-headed
Umamusume born into the Mejiro family.
And—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bright's Trainer...
Hello...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Extremely shy. The distance between her and myself,
as Mejiro Bright's Trainer, remains as far as ever...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, let's both do our best~.
And then..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Glory to Mejiro, without fail. Just like McQueen-sama and Ryan-onesama~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, I just came to check on you...
This is kinda embarrassing. Having you
praise me so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, you two. I heard the news.
Your debut in the Twinkle Series has been decided.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer!
Please take good care of Bright from now on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Mejiro Ryan.
Deeply adored by Mejiro Bright, she's one of the
foremost racers representing the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan's greatest weapon is, without a doubt...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Sister Ryan, I truly look up to you.
I wish I could rush up from behind like whoosh~ in a race just like you do~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, come to think of it, Bright,
you were watching my final spurt like your eyes were glued to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, give it your best shot! I know you've got what it takes to master it, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright's long, sustained burst of speed might very well be something she learned and inherited from Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to say that Mejiro Bright has high expectations
from the Mejiro family right now. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-sama, from here on out,
let us walk hand in hand together~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The sunlight filtering through the trees is dazzling~
Even if I am in the shade right now... I will surely reach the Mejiro light~!
